<script id="cdqV2502NativeApkShareJs">
(function(){
'use strict';
function go(u){var a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.target='_top';a.style.display='none';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();}
function share(){go('intent://share#Intent;scheme=cdqapp;package=ca.balancecdq.android;end');}
function reinstall(){go('intent://reinstall#Intent;scheme=cdqapp;package=ca.balancecdq.android;end');}
function update(){go('intent://check#Intent;scheme=cdqupdate;package=ca.balancecdq.android;end');}
function wire(){
  var b=document.getElementById('cdqInstallShareSettingsButton')||document.getElementById('cdqAdminApkButtonV2501');
  if(b&&!b.dataset.cdq2502){b.dataset.cdq2502='1';b.onclick=function(e){e&&e.preventDefault();share();};}
}
window.cdqOuvrirPartageApplication=share;
window.cdqPartagerApkDirectV2502=share;
window.cdqReinstallerApkV2502=reinstall;
window.cdqMajApkV2502=update;
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){setTimeout(wire,100);setTimeout(wire,600);},{once:true});else{setTimeout(wire,30);setTimeout(wire,600);}
try{new MutationObserver(function(){setTimeout(wire,80);}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});}catch(_){}
})();
</script>

<script id="cdqV2503UpdateHandoffJs">
(function(){
'use strict';
const MANAGER_BASE='https://jprodrigue86.github.io/Rapports--talonnages-CDQ/apps-script-manager/';
const ANDROID_FALLBACK='https://jprodrigue86.github.io/Rapports--talonnages-CDQ/balance-cdq-android.html';

function latestBundle(){
  let build='';
  try{build=String((window.cdqUpdateInfo&&window.cdqUpdateInfo.latest)||'');}catch(_){}
  const m=build.match(/v(\d+\.\d+)/i);
  return m?('v'+m[1]):'latest';
}
function openScriptManager(){
  const url=MANAGER_BASE+'?bundle='+encodeURIComponent(latestBundle());
  try{
    if(window.parent&&window.parent!==window){
      window.parent.postMessage({type:'CDQ_OPEN_SCRIPT_MANAGER',url:url},'*');
      return;
    }
  }catch(_){}
  location.href=url;
}
function openAndroidUpdater(){
  try{if(typeof window.cdqMajApkV2502==='function'){window.cdqMajApkV2502();return;}}catch(_){}
  const intent='intent://check#Intent;scheme=cdqupdate;package=ca.balancecdq.android;S.browser_fallback_url='+encodeURIComponent(ANDROID_FALLBACK)+';end';
  location.href=intent;
}
function refresh(){
  const center=document.querySelector('.cdq-update-center');
  if(!center)return;
  const help=center.querySelector('.cdq-update-help');
  if(help)help.textContent='Balance CDQ / Selector se met à jour avec Script Manager. La couche Android se met à jour séparément.';
  const install=center.querySelector('#cdqInstallUpdateButton');
  if(install&&!install.disabled){
    install.textContent='Mettre à jour via Script Manager';
    install.title='Ouvrir Script Manager avec la version disponible';
  }
  let android=center.querySelector('#cdqAndroidUpdaterButtonV2316');
  if(!android){
    android=document.createElement('button');
    android.type='button';
    android.id='cdqAndroidUpdaterButtonV2316';
    android.textContent='Vérifier la mise à jour Android';
    const actions=center.querySelector('.cdq-update-actions');
    if(actions)actions.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',android); else center.appendChild(android);
  }
}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  const target=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest('button'):null;
  if(!target)return;
  if(target.id==='cdqInstallUpdateButton' || (target.closest('#cdqUpdateBanner') && /mettre à jour/i.test(target.textContent||''))){
    e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();openScriptManager();return;
  }
  if(target.id==='cdqAndroidUpdaterButtonV2316'){
    e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();openAndroidUpdater();
  }
},true);
function schedule(){clearTimeout(window.__cdqV2503Refresh);window.__cdqV2503Refresh=setTimeout(refresh,50);}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){schedule();setTimeout(schedule,400);},{once:true});else schedule();
window.addEventListener('load',function(){setTimeout(schedule,150);});
window.addEventListener('message',function(){setTimeout(schedule,60);});
try{new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});}catch(_){}
})();
</script>
